select SUBSTRING(max(u.user_no), 8) from user u
where u.user_no like concat('%',#{userNo},'%')

SELECT uu.gradeName,group_concat(uu.className SEPARATOR ',') as className, group_concat(uu.classCount SEPARATOR ',') as classCount from( SELECT cg.title as gradeName,cc.title as className,count(u.classs) as classCount, cg.sort_by as dgs,cc.sort_by as dcs from `user` u left join course cg on cg.id=u.grade left join course cc on cc.id=u.classs where u.`status`='be4521e9b35b81ffc52eee3b9eff01c4'
and u.classs in
#{item}
GROUP BY cg.title,cc.title,cg.sort_by,cc.sort_by ORDER BY cg.sort_by asc,cc.sort_by asc )uu GROUP BY uu.gradeName,uu.dgs ORDER BY uu.dgs
